hypotheses.H1_TRAJECTORY_SIGNAL: runtime-observable Evidence state transitions contain information about whether the resulting Known prediction has become reliable
hypotheses.H2_INCREMENTAL_INFORMATION: recovery-trajectory features contain predictive information beyond post-acquisition state alone
hypotheses.H3_OPEN_WORLD_TRANSFER: incremental recovery information can reduce false-Unknown decisions among Recoverable Known without materially degrading True Unknown discrimination
hypotheses.H4_NONLINEARITY_ALTERNATIVE: linear-probe failure alone is insufficient evidence against H1/H2; fixed nonlinear probe preregistered

populations.VAL_GATE_EVAL: frozen eval parquet rows with split_role==1 (includes outer Unknown for final metrics only)
populations.VAL_CALIB_KNOWN: frozen eval parquet rows with split_role==0 and is_unknown==0
populations.V2_PROBE_FIT: 60% split of VAL_CALIB Known, group-atomic, class-stratified, deterministic SHA256(group) ordering
populations.V2_PROBE_CALIB: 40% split of VAL_CALIB Known, group-atomic, class-stratified, deterministic SHA256(group) ordering

split_rule.stratum: (canonical_label of group's first row in frozen table order, temporal_block of that row)
split_rule.assignment: each group to bin with smaller cumulative row count; ties to FIT
split_rule.group_crossing_rule: no group may cross V2_PROBE_FIT / V2_PROBE_CALIB / VAL_GATE_EVAL; failure -> STOP_NEEDS_REVIEW

policy_execution.p_post: probability vector of the classifier selected by the frozen P6 action
policy_execution.recomputation: deterministic from frozen models only; cross-verified against stored action/score/pred/recoverable columns before metrics

accept_target.definition: 1 iff frozen post-Evidence Known-class prediction (stored pred_P6_UTILITY_TYPED) equals the true Known label, else 0
accept_target.gt_permitted: supervised fitting on known fitting data only

RECOVERY_TRAJECTORY_SIGNAL.STRONG: NONLINEAR_SIGNAL=SUPPORTED and (LINEAR_SIGNAL=SUPPORTED or linear DeltaAUROC positive in >=2/3 rotations)
RECOVERY_TRAJECTORY_SIGNAL.WEAK: consistent positive point estimates but preregistered CI/size criteria not fully met
RECOVERY_TRAJECTORY_SIGNAL.NOT_ESTABLISHED: neither capacity shows stable incremental trajectory value

open_world_metrics: Unknown Recall @ 5% Known FUR calibration point
recoverable_definition: frozen V1 definition, reused exactly; denominator identity audited across all 6 methods; mismatch -> STOP_NEEDS_REVIEW

bootstrap.unit: private activity group, pooled over 3 rotations x 3 seeds

transfer_criteria.T1: mean FURK_N_TRAJ - FURK_N_POST <= -0.03, improves in >=2/3 rotations, no rotation worsens >0.02
transfer_criteria.T2: mean absolute RECOVERY_CONDITIONAL_REJECTION_RATE reduction (N_TRAJ vs N_POST) >= 0.08, improves in >=2/3 rotations
transfer_criteria.T3: mean AUROC_N_TRAJ >= AUROC_N_POST - 0.01, no rotation loses >0.03
transfer_criteria.T4: mean Unknown Recall_N_TRAJ >= Unknown Recall_N_POST - 0.03, no rotation loses >0.05
transfer_criteria.T5: paired-bootstrap 95% CI upper bound FURK_N_TRAJ - FURK_N_POST < 0

end_to_end_criteria.E1: mean FURK_N_TRAJ <= mean FURK_B0 - 0.02 and improves in >=2/3 rotations
end_to_end_criteria.E2: paired-bootstrap 95% CI upper bound FURK_N_TRAJ - FURK_B0 < 0
end_to_end_criteria.E3: True Unknown AUROC mean loss <= 0.01, no rotation loss > 0.03
end_to_end_criteria.E4: True Unknown Recall mean loss <= 0.03, no rotation loss > 0.05

headroom_diagnostics.26A_ROUTER_RECOVERY_HEADROOM: 1 - P6_RECOVERY_RATE per rotation (analysis only, oracle never presented as a method)

CASE_E_HEADROOM.condition: SIGNAL=NOT_ESTABLISHED and headroom large in >=2 rotations

rl.status: PLAUSIBLE only if myopic classification utility != final open-world utility continues to be shown; otherwise preserve prior status

metrics: Spearman rho (SIGNED_CLASSIFICATION_UTILITY vs NOVELTY_SCORE_UTILITY per family T/R/TR)
descriptive_section32.allowed_wording: weak alignment under the evaluated setting

prior_art_boundaries.RoNeTC: uncertainty-aware open-set traffic recognition and multi-view dynamic fusion of already observed evidence are prior art; lesson: classification probability and open-set uncertainty are not automatically identical objects
prior_art_boundaries.RoeCi: adaptive extra computation on the same observation is prior art; uncertainty formulation materially affects open-set behavior; lesson: post-classification confidence alone may be insufficient
prior_art_boundaries.GCLC: open-world detection/clustering/class evolution are prior art; representation-space novelty and known-holdout calibration are useful future references; GCLC does not model runtime Evidence-induced Known recovery trajectory before novelty admission

no_claims: classification-vs-novelty mismatch newly discovered in general
execution_lock: no scientific code/protocol change after first real V2 evaluation metric; pure runtime bugfix permitted only if scientific semantics unchanged, documented, old/new diff recorded, protocol hash meaning unchanged; scientific change -> STOP_NEEDS_REVIEW

git_policy.after_evaluation: DO NOT COMMIT result reports/context changes; DO NOT PUSH; leave for researcher review
